cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check port 3000
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep 3000")
print("Port 3000:", stdout.read().decode())
# Test with curl
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000 2>&1 || echo failed")
print("\nCurl:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check ip:3000 from outside
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://46.202.154.25:3000 2>&1 || echo failed")
print("\nExternal:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
